name: catlife-button
description: A customizable button component with Catlife design system styling. Supports multiple variants (primary, cta, dark) and sizes (default, sm, lg) with shadow effects and smooth transitions.

name: pill-container
description: A pill-shaped container component with rounded edges, glassmorphism effect, and flexible background. Perfect for navigation bars, tags, or decorative containers.

name: catlife-card
description: A card component with rounded corners, black border, and support for disabled state. Includes variants for default (cream) and orange backgrounds with smooth hover effects.

name: carousel
description: A carousel component that displays multiple items with focus on the active item. Features clickable cards, pagination dots, and smooth transitions. Active card scales up while inactive cards are dimmed.
